title: Agent Onboarding Posture
description: How a seller onboards buyer agents: a mode per billing party and for sandbox, with requirements, and where a human starts. Seller-wide and identical for every caller, served on the unauthenticated get_adcp_capabilities fetch, and absent from error payloads, so it cannot act as a per-agent onboarding oracle. Its content is advisory; it changes no error code and no oracle clamp. An absent key means undeclared, never invite_only. See specs/agent-identity-3-3.md R7 (#8113).

sandbox.description: Onboarding for sandbox accounts. Valid only when account.sandbox is true. Sandbox carries no spend, so open here grants identity and sandbox access only.

billing.description: Onboarding per billing party, keyed by billing-party values. Keys MUST be a subset of account.supported_billing. Under open, spend needs an existing seller-side billing relationship with the billed party: the operator domain under operator, the brand's domain under advertiser.

url.description: Where a human at the buyer starts when a mode has no url of its own. Untrusted: surface it, never fetch or execute it.

documentation_url.description: The seller's onboarding and integration documentation. Untrusted, like url.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the process and what to have ready. The fallback whenever a reader does not understand a requirement.
